meta.title: 岁月故事 · LifePoem — your memories, preserved forever
meta.description: LifePoem is a warm, AI-guided app that helps elderly users preserve life stories through voice or text—in Chinese, English, Malay, or Tamil.

contact.metaDescription: Reach out to the LifePoem team for support or partnership inquiries.
contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: We would love to hear from you. Send us a message and our team will reply as soon as possible.
contact.successMessage: Thanks for reaching out. We received your message.
contact.errorMessage: Please check your details and try again.

hero.name: LifePoem
hero.intro: A warm, AI-guided chat for elderly storytellers: speak a memory, answer gentle questions, and watch it become a beautiful written story—in Chinese or English.
hero.imageAlt: LifePoem — Your Voice, Your Legacy. A voice-first memoir for older adults, made in English, 中文, Bahasa Melayu, and தமிழ்.
hero.appStoreAlt: Download Life Poem on the App Store

valueProps.heading: Made for real conversations
valueProps.sub: Large touch targets, clear type, and no time pressure—so the focus stays on the person telling the story.

items.title: AI-guided storytelling
items.body: Gentle follow-up questions across life stages so each memory becomes a full chapter—at a pace that never feels rushed.

items.title: Speak or type
items.body: Hold to record with transcription, or use the keyboard. Stories can be written in Chinese or English anytime.

items.title: Save and share
items.body: Streamed story text, readable fonts, and export to image cards for family on WhatsApp, WeChat, and more.

screenshots.heading: Inside the app
screenshots.sub: Use the arrows or dots to browse six screens from LifePoem.

slides.title: A gentle start
slides.body: A calm welcome and typing animation—no rush, no clutter—before the conversation begins.

slides.title: Life stages
slides.body: Move through childhood, family, work, and more. Progress lives in one simple hub.

slides.title: Chat that listens
slides.body: Speak or type; the app asks one warm question at a time so memories surface naturally.

slides.title: Your rhythm
slides.body: Large controls, readable type, and bilingual support—Chinese or English whenever you want.

slides.title: Stories take shape
slides.body: Watch chapters stream in with a typewriter feel, tuned for comfortable reading.

slides.title: Share the legacy
slides.body: Export a polished card to WhatsApp, WeChat, and other channels the family already uses.
